question: Should OpenClaw officially support Android/Termux as a Gateway host, and if so which lifecycle, auth, dashboard exposure, update, and real-device validation model is supported?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally exclude Android from Gateway hosting, but adding it changes platform scope, service lifecycle, network exposure, and mobile security posture beyond a safe autonomous fix.

options.title: Define scoped Android host mode
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify one supported Android/Termux hosting model with security, lifecycle, docs, and real-device validation requirements.

options.title: Keep Android node-only
options.body: Document that Android remains a companion node and mobile-only users should use a remote host, SSH/Tailscale path, or clearly unofficial external stack.

options.title: External ecosystem only
options.body: Treat AndroidForClaw-style full-device hosting as external ecosystem work unless it identifies a missing OpenClaw core API.

recommendation.title: Define scoped Android host mode
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify one supported Android/Termux hosting model with security, lifecycle, docs, and real-device validation requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a project-level platform and security direction choice, with Gateway and Android owners as reviewers.
